evals.name: Ecosystem Health & Hard Limits Audit
evals.prompt: Run a full health and security audit on the ai-agent-toolkit repository and output an ecosystem scorecard.
evals.expected_output: Static toolkit audit report covering authoring-policy skill size, Antigravity 24,000-byte rule file limit, workflow migration candidates, and heuristic domain token checks.
assertions: Applies the toolkit 500-line SKILL.md authoring policy and Antigravity 24,000-byte per-rule source limit
Flags legacy workflow files as migration candidates without claiming a fixed removal date
Reports known-domain keyword matches as heuristics, not comprehensive secret or privacy assurance

evals.name: Global Parity & Token Budget Audit
evals.prompt: Run --check-global to inspect ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md source-file size; distinguish this limited check from unimplemented global skill parity.
evals.expected_output: Reports global rule source byte size and explicitly marks full global skill/parity and aggregate token-budget verification as not implemented.
assertions: Checks ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md against the 24,000 UTF-8-byte per-file Antigravity rule limit
Does not claim orphan skill detection or timestamp parity without implementing it
Reports global_parity_verified: false and a correctly scoped health scorecard
